about_short_description.short_description: Get custom internal tools to unblock customer success, support, and operations, fast

product.name: Dropbase AI Software Builder
product.description: A platform for building custom internal web apps and automation software using natural language, drag-and-drop UI adjustments, and Python code.

product.name: Database Editors
product.description: Spreadsheet-like interfaces to view, edit, and collaborate on data across multiple databases and APIs with granular access control.

product.name: Admin Panels
product.description: Customizable admin interfaces to manage user accounts, billing, subscriptions, and operational tasks.

product.name: Approval Dashboards
product.description: Dashboards to review, approve, or reject customer applications and onboard new users efficiently.

product.name: Cloud Consoles
product.description: Interfaces to monitor, restart, and manage cloud infrastructure and resources such as servers and databases.

product.name: Notification Systems
product.description: Systems to send templated email or SMS notifications triggered by user actions or system events.
